slice: RPP-5lb selected AC1027 four-element MLINE retarget tail append
scope: Qualifies one source-bound AC1027 retarget from a four-element MLINE style to another source-bound style after appending one fifth tail element. The test verifies exact emitted style and consumer data, ownership, fresh readback, failure rollback, late-mutation refusal and same-adapter retry. This is a selected profile only.

references.use: Groups 71 and 49 encode the element count and offsets, with repeated 49/62/6 element tuples; group 70 contains style flags. These definitions do not prescribe how to regenerate MLINE consumer geometry.

Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object, group 2 is its redundant name, group 73 records style element count, groups 74/41 describe each vertex's segment parameters, groups 75/42 describe fill parameters, and groups 13/23/33 carry vertex miter vectors.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 source. The original and target style geometries each have flags 2, angles 90/90, offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0], and four ordered element tuples. The original tuple colors/LTYPEs are [1,3,4,5] and [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous]; the target tuple colors/LTYPEs are [5,7,4,5] with the same LTYPE order. Two source-bound MLINE consumers have three vertices and are owned by model space and a named block. The target edit appends offset -3.0, ACI 4, ByLayer and retargets both consumers by group-340 identity while preserving group-2 names.
contract.projection: Require the exact 4-to-5 target tail append, preserve all four source offsets as an ordered prefix, and keep flags 2 and angles 90/90. Recompute each consumer's first group-41 parameter against the target's full minimum offset (-3.0), preserving source vertex positions, segment directions, miter geometry and zero second parameters. Bottom justification uses the resulting +3.0 shift. This is not a general MLINE regeneration algorithm.
contract.outputAndReadback: Across ASCII/binary source and output, verify both style records and dictionary ownership/keys; group 70/71/49/62/6 style fields; both MLINE group-340 references, preserved group-2 names, group 73=5, exact group 74/75/41 arrays and groups 13/23/33; model-space/block ownership; and fresh import of both style records and both consumers with the expected five-element target and projected arrays.
contract.failureAndRetry: For each output encoding, perturb an existing target offset and prove refusal preserves the destination sentinel and caller snapshot; restoring the source permits a same-adapter retry with full output/readback proof. A late consumer-parameter mutation also refuses atomically; restoring caller state permits retry. The selected 4-to-5 case has four successful source/output encoding combinations, two source-mutation refusals, two late-mutation refusals and four successful retries.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. DXF sources and outputs are authored at runtime under a temporary directory and removed after passing runs. No drawing fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers only AC1027 source count 4 to target count 5 by one tail append, the exact flags, angles, offsets and tuple fields above, and two source-bound open/uncut/unfilled three-vertex consumers. Other source counts, append batches, flags, angles, offsets, schemas, carriers, versions, native CAD semantics, complete-document closure and broader support claims remain unqualified.

controls.observed: The focused selector covers this case alongside source counts 2 and 3: aggregate successful profiles=12; output/readback proofs including retries=24; source-mutation refusals with rollback=6; late-mutation refusals with rollback=6; same-adapter retries=12. The four source-count-four profiles, two source-mutation refusals, two late-mutation refusals and four retries are bound by the selector's sourceCount==4 loop cases.
controls.runtimeFixturePolicy: The focused test creates the DXF source and all outputs at runtime; it adds no DWG/DXF fixture to the repository.

focusedSuite.summary: All four focused MLINE retarget/append tests passed (4/4); the retarget-append selector covers source counts 2, 3 and 4.
